source.note: FIXTURE. Nothing here is deployed. A Milady vault of 20 items and 9 tickets, drawn with REAL drand evmnet beacons (rounds served by api.drand.sh and api2.drand.sh on 2026-09-27) through EthNftWrapper's own formula, over an invented Robinhood Chain and Ethereum. The collection's address is Milady's; the wrapper, custodian, module, transactions and every trait are invented, and the explorer links point at nothing. Ticket 4's burn is made to look back-dated and ticket 5's batch unreadable, to show the verifier's timing flag.
Recomputed on this machine from the providers named on each number; no Rook service was asked.
